stages.effectText: Increases the max number of Support Devices that can be held by +1 and reduces their Deployment Cost

Carries 3 Support Devices (max 2 can be deployed at once) that grant an Operator a Barrier equal to 25% of Catherine's Max HP (if the target has not received an attack within 5 seconds, Barrier replenishes by 6% of Catherine's Max HP every second, cannot go over the starting limit); effects from Devices do not stack

Carries 3 Support Devices (max 2 can be deployed at once) that grant an Operator a Barrier equal to 28% of Catherine's Max HP (if the target has not received an attack within 5 seconds, Barrier replenishes by 6% of Catherine's Max HP every second, cannot go over the starting limit); effects from Devices do not stack
